title: Vector Quantizer Encoder
text: 基于欧几里得距离或加权欧几里得距离度量得出的最近码字索引，输入 3 路、输出 3 路、无直接馈通；按 {Rounding mode} 指定舍入模式；{Source of codebook} 指定码本来源 Specify via、{Codebook} 指定码本值、{Distortion measure} 指定失真度量 Squared、{Source of weighting factor} 指定加权因子的来源 Specify via、{Weighting factor} 指定加权因子、{Tie-breaking rule} 指定打破平局规则 Choose the lower、{Output codeword} 输出码字、{Output quantization error} 输出量化误差、{Index output data type} 指定索引输出数据类型、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定对整数溢出进行饱和、{Product output} 指定乘积输出数据类型 Same、{Word length} 指定乘积输出字长、{Fraction length} 指定乘积输出小数长度、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型 Same as product，按实例取值。

ports.name: D
ports.summary: 量化误差 scalar | row vector

params.name: Source of codebook
params.values: 码本来源 Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Distortion measure
params.values: 失真度量 Squared error (default) | Weighted squared error

params.name: Source of weighting factor
params.values: 加权因子的来源 Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Tie-breaking rule
params.values: 打破平局规则 Choose the lower index (default) | Choose the higher index

params.name: Output quantization error
params.values: 输出量化误差 off (default) | on

params.name: Index output data type
params.values: 索引输出数据类型 int32 (default) | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | uint32 | Inherit via back propagation

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 对整数溢出进行饱和 off (default) | on

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Same as input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Word length
params.values: 乘积输出字长 16 (default) | positive integer in range [2,128]

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: 乘积输出小数长度 15 (default) | integer

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Same as product output (default) | Same as input | Binary point scaling
